# AiIcon

An icon for an AI action: generate, ask, rewrite, summarize, plan, suggest or stop generating. Each badged icon is a Font Awesome Free glyph with one four-point sparkle in its top-right corner and a clean gap cut around it. Generate is the sparkle alone, and stop generating has none because stopping is not generative. - **name** picks the icon. - **size** is 16 (the default) or 24. Generate and stop generating also have 12. Asking another icon for 12 draws it at 16 and warns. - **label** names the icon for assistive technology. Without it the icon is hidden, so pair it with visible text. The shapes fill with `currentColor`, which starts at the icon color; set `color` to change it. Pair every icon with a label unless its meaning is obvious.

**Import:** `import { AiIcon } from '@/components';`

## Usage

Use `AiIcon` to mark an action that the AI performs. For any other action, use a Font Awesome Free glyph. Stop generating has no sparkle on purpose, because stopping is not generative.

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Pair the icon with the verb: "Summarize". | An icon alone for an action that is not obvious. |
| Use the icon that names the action. | Reuse one icon for a different action. |

## Best practices

### Pair it with visible text, or give it a `label`. {#pair-it-with-visible-text-or-give-it-a-label}

Without `label` the icon is hidden from assistive technology.

Do: The icon beside the verb it stands for.
Don't: A bare icon with no text and no label, so it has no name.

### Pick `name` from the set. {#pick-name-from-the-set}

`generate`, `ask`, `rewrite`, `summarize`, `plan`, `suggest` and `stop-generating`.

Do: One icon for each action it names.
Don't: One icon reused for different actions.

### Use it for AI actions only. {#use-it-for-ai-actions-only}

An AI icon marks something generative. Use a plain Font Awesome icon for an action that is not.

Do: The sparkle marks something generative.
Don't: The sparkle on an action that is not AI.

## Accessibility

- **Labeled or hidden.** With `label` the icon is `role="img"` named by it. Without, it is `aria-hidden`.
- **Color follows the text.** It fills with `currentColor`, so it keeps contrast with its surroundings.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `name` | oneOf | `'generate'` | Which action the icon stands for. |
| `size` | enum | `16` | The icon's size in px. 12 exists for generate and stop-generating only. |
| `label` | string | — | An accessible name. Without it the icon is hidden from assistive technology. |
| `className` | string | `''` | — |
| `style` | object | — | — |

## Variants

**`name`** — `generate` · `ask` · `rewrite` · `summarize` · `plan` · `suggest` · `stop-generating`

**`size`** — `12` · `16` · `24`

Anything not listed is not a valid value.
